data.one_liner: Dart extensions, utilities, form validators, responsive helpers, API models, and an in-app DevTools panel.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of Dart and Flutter utilities including null-safe checks, type conversion extensions, form validators, responsive layout helpers, an API json model mixin without code generation, and an in-app DevTools overlay for inspecting network requests and logs.
use_when: You want common extensions and utilities without importing multiple small packages.
You need an easy way to define JSON API models with zero code generation.
You want a lightweight in-app DevTools panel to inspect network traffic and logs on device.
avoid_when: You need strictly typed code-generated models via build_runner like freezed or json_serializable.
You only need a single isolated helper function and want to avoid adding a large dependency.
strengths: Includes a wide variety of helpful utilities in a single package (extensions, validators, responsive helpers, devtools).
API models mixin parses JSON safely with zero code generation requirements.
In-app DevTools panel works seamlessly on device with search and filtering.
weaknesses: A single package containing many unrelated utilities may increase scope if you only need a small portion.
Relies on mixins and runtime parsing for models rather than compile-time generated code.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency and optionally attach the DevTools overlay and interceptor to your MaterialApp and Dio instances.
